findings.claim: The replica cutover clears synchronized rows and checkpoints but does not actually start a new local generation in the migration SQL, contrary to the claimed controlled generation cutover and leaving generation-based stale-resume fencing dependent on the unchanged schema plan value.
findings.evidence: CURRENT web/src/shared/sync/pglite-schema.ts defines PGLITE_CASE_SUMMARY_SQL with TRUNCATE of synchronized tables and optional TRUNCATE of _replica_checkpoints, but it contains no update to _replica_meta.generation; CURRENT .refiner/artifacts/.../decisions.md claims "Revision 6 performs a controlled local-replica cutover" and "clears all synchronized rows and any checkpoint before the required columns are added; the next authorized pass refetches the complete graph."
findings.suggested_fix: In the same migration transaction, update the replica metadata generation (when _replica_meta exists) before/with checkpoint clearing, or otherwise make the migration-ledger plan assign a strictly new generation for this cutover and test that currentGeneration changes across the populated upgrade.
